    (interleave ys xs).length = ys.length + xs.length := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => 
      simp [interleave] <;> rw [ih] <;> ring

theorem length_interleave (xs ys : List α) :
    (interleave xs ys).length = xs.length + ys.length := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp [interleave] <;> rw [ih] <;> ring
